title: Pillar & Menu Allocation
subtitle: Assign exclusive ownership of each business pillar to a single Syailendra Group entity
exclusivityDesc: A pillar can only be owned by one company. Selecting a new company for a pillar automatically revokes it from the previous owner. Every company must own at least one pillar.
matrixSubtitle: Click a button in a company column to move pillar ownership
emptyEntityError: {code} must own at least one pillar
